initial_decision.brief_rationale: R138-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the causal effect by standardization over Z. Each stratum has population weight 0.5; its risk difference is 0 or -0.2. The average causal risk difference is therefore -0.1.
